system.description: When you use your Deflection flurry technique against a ranged attack, or an effect originating from a hostile creature that is not adjacent to you, but is within 60 feet of you, you can spend 1 additional Discipline. When you do, you redirect the reduced damage to another creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Make a ranged weapon attack using your held weapon, targeting the creature you are redirecting the damage to. On a hit, they take your [Weapon Damage] plus the damage you reduced with the Deflection flurry technique.
